scope: 单页面入口脚本加载与本地双击运行可行性依据
content: MDN 官方文档 <script> 指出：The defer Boolean attribute indicates that the script is meant to be executed after the document has been parsed, but before firing DOMContentLoaded event. The defer attribute has no effect on module scripts — they defer by default. 经典脚本配合 defer 能够实现不阻塞解析并在 DOM 就绪前执行，且不受 module 脚本在 file:// 协议下的跨域安全限制。
conclusion: HTML <script defer> 在经典脚本中在文档解析后、DOMContentLoaded 触发前执行，无 CORS 限制，支持 file:// 本地直接运行。
